episodes.title: Episode 1
episodes.summary: Maya attends the funeral of her murdered husband Joe at his family's stately home — then thinks she sees him, days later, on a hidden nanny cam.

episodes.title: Episode 2
episodes.summary: News about the murder weapon sets the investigation on a new course. Maya goes searching for answers and learns something surprising about her sister.

episodes.title: Episode 3
episodes.summary: Maya chases the car that's been following her. With the adults distracted, Claire's children investigate the mystery of their mother's old photo.

episodes.title: Episode 4
episodes.summary: The detectives question the owner of the motorbike from the crime scene. Kierce's condition catches up with him at a critical moment.

episodes.title: Episode 5
episodes.summary: Maya sees an unexpected face when she takes Lily to see her grandmother. Kierce struggles to come to terms with his test results.

episodes.title: Episode 6
episodes.summary: Suspicion falls on Maya when she's found at a crime scene — but she's the one who makes an accusation. McGreggor discovers something new about Kierce.

episodes.title: Episode 7
episodes.summary: As the police close in on a suspect, Maya decides to take drastic action. Shane begs her for answers — and learns the truth about their shared past.

episodes.title: Episode 8
episodes.summary: With the last pieces of the puzzle starting to fall into place, Maya confronts her husband's family one last time, and Kierce seeks help from Corey.
